newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close 1.7 pct up, CA strong.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close 1.7 pct up, CA strong.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares firmed 1.7 percent on Friday, buoyed by buying interest that centred on Creditanstalt Bankverein. Some market participants traced ATX index strength to window dressing before year-end and forecast the upward trend would continue on Monday.
* January ATX future up 20.8 points at 1,149.8
* Creditanstalt preferred the biggest gainer, up 6.98 pct at 496.9 ats. Finance ministry decision on whether to reopen CA sale tender expected imminently
* Bank Austria preferred the biggest decliner, down 0.74 pct at 403 ats after EU commission asked for details of Bank Austria bid for CA
* Vienna Bourse index up 5.41 points at 430.37 -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
